title: MIT ion plane credits obscure 1920s scientist

tellings.quote: MIT has demonstrated a plane with no moving parts, their ion plane.

plain: In 2018 MIT, the engineering university in Massachusetts, flew a model "ion plane", an aircraft pushed along by electrically charged air with no moving parts. The researcher Jan Lundquist points to it in a documentary episode about the inventor Townsend Brown, without naming a source, and the story ties the work back to an obscure scientist of the 1920s. It is told as proof that an old, overlooked idea about silent propulsion actually works.
